titulo: Meet the new Black Panther: British actor David Jonsson cast as T’Challa’s son in ‘Black Panther 3’
cuerpo: British actor David Jonsson has been revealed as the new Black Panther in surprise Comic-Con announcement this weekend. The 32-year-old rose to fame on HBO’s hit show ‘Industry’ before wowing audiences in 'Rye Lane' and 'Alien: Romulus'.
